notes.title: Release v1.5.1
notes.content:
Greetings,

Apologies for the delay in delivering this update, but it is with great joy that I can say that the release v1.5.1 is now available!

Below are the patch notes for this release.

[h3]Release Notes[/h3]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*][b]New Options Menu[/b]
[u]Revamped the existing options menu to be divided into multiple categories and included the new input remapping system and some gameplay related settings.

[/u][/*][*][b]New Dungeon System[/b]
[u]Revamped the dungeon system to display a new window with paths the player can take to reach the final boss, instead of a procedurally generated dungeon map

[/u][/*][*][b]Button mapping System[/b]
[u]Implemented a new system in the options menu to remap the keybinds

[/u][/*][*][b]Replace shop with merchants[/b]
[u]Replaced the "supermarket" from Aramore Town with new shop stalls with plans to create more in the next release.

[/u][/*][*][b]Redesign Aramore Town[/b]
[u]Started redesigning Aramore Town to look more appealing and lively

[/u][/*][/list][h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3][list][*][b]Mana Blast is casting Lightning[/b]
[u]Fixed certain spells not showing the correct name, example: in certain cases, Lightning was showing up as Mana Blast

[/u][/*][*][b]Carrot item is displaying as "Black Pants" in it's name[/b]
[u]Fixed the "Carrot" item displaying as "Black Pants" when picked up from crops and in the item menu.

[/u][/*][*][b]Bat sprite is missing[/b]
[u]Fixed bat monster not displaying the right sprite when fighting

[/u][/*][*][b]Shop options displaying on top of Shop Window[/b]
[u]Fixed an issue where the message options for the shopkeep were displaying on top of the Buy/Sell window

[/u][/*][*][b]Shop window is open, the NPC can still be interacted with[/b]
[u]Fixed an issue where the Shop window was open but the NPC could still be interacted with, causing an issue where the message for that shopkeep would appear even though the Shop window was open.

[/u][/*][/list]

That is all for this update.

I hope you continue to enjoy the game!

For the progress of the next release or to give feedback/report issues, please go to: [url=https://tickets.omegaleo.pt/project/nemithia/release/v152]Issue Tracker - Nemithia[/url]

Thank you for reading and I'll see you on the next update!

notes.title: Release v1.5.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

I'm happy to announce that the newest version of Nemithia is now live, after a long development process.

I want to also apologize for the delays in getting this update out. I had a lot of personal issues during the last year and ended up not being able to proceed with the development as I had hoped to.
Hopefully, the next updates won't take as long to come out!

With that out of the way, let's go to the release notes!

[h3]Release Notes[/h3]
[h4]New Features[/h4]
[list]
[*][b]Menu Overhaul[/b]
[u]Fight menu:
	Changed from buttons with text to icons
Pause Menu:
	Added icons to the options in the Pause Menu
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Stat growth popup[/b]
[u][olist][*][u][/u]Remade the Victory screen to show the character's exp gain/level up separately and then show the item drops earned from the fight;[/*][*][u][/u]Remade the Defeat screen to be separate from the Victory Screen to better highlight a defeat.[/*][/olist][/u][/*]
[*][b]New Music[/b]
[u]Added new music for the following:
[olist][*][u][/u]Title Screen[/*][*][u][/u]Arcade[/*][*][u][/u]Boss battle[/*][*][u][/u]Aramore Forest[/*][*][u][/u]Fights[/*][*][u][/u]Intro Chapter when the Drakians are invading[/*][/olist][/u][/*]
[*][b]Fight music[/b]
[u]Fixed fight music speeding up whenever a party member is below 25% and make it trigger only when the party's average hp is below 25%
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Chapter 1 Remake[/b]
[u]
The 1st chapter of the story has been remade to include more lore about the world, the tale of Arthur Runescar, and more.
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Team + Character + Item menu overhaul[/b]
[u]

[olist][*][u][/u]Party now shows as orange-colored characters in the Team Menu[/*][*][u][/u]The team menu now shows characters on both pages[/*][*][u][/u]The item menu was changed to a tabbed window that filters items by category[/*][*][u][/u]Character summary now shows tabs for:[/*][*][u][/u]Character info + stats[/*][*][u][/u]Grimoire and Spells[/*][*][u][/u]Equipment[/*][*][u][/u]Element mastery[/*][/olist][/u][/*]
[*][b]Improvements to load times[/b]
[u]
[u]Slight improvement to the load times by optimizing the code to generate sprites based on the character's equipment.[/u]
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Crops respawn time[/b]
[u]Crops respawn timer has been set to 30 minutes of real-world time.
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Intro[/b]
[u]
Added Story Intro and tutorial so the player can learn more about the world and the story
[/u][/*]
[*][b]New Character Sprites[/b]
[u]
Remade all character sprites in a new style
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Minigame adjustments[/b]
[u][olist][*][u][/u]Less time for boulder breaking minigame[/*][*][u][/u]Less time for dodge the rocks game[/*][*][u][/u]Give some money back at the end of the game[/*][*][u][/u]Give some item rewards depending on the game[/*][*][u][/u]Possible rewards:[/*][*][u][/u]Collectibles[/*][*][u][/u]Items to raise a certain stat[/*][/olist][/u][/*]
[*][b]Fight System adjustments[/b]
[u]
Performance improvements to the fighting system
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Interior Lighting[/b]
[u]Added lights to the interior of houses, shops, etc.
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Mobs in overworld[/b]
[u]
Mobs will now spawn in the overworld instead of being random encounters, some will also run towards the player.
[/u][/*]
[*][b]New Health and Mana icons[/b]
[u]Added new HP and MP icons for fights to highlight better what the bars represent
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Skip dialogue button[/b]
[u]Added a button to skip dialogue, currently mapped to Backspace on the keyboard.
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Day/Night Cycle improvements[/b]
[u]Changed the Day/Night cycle so that 1 real-world hour equals 1 day in the game
[/u][/*]
[/list]
[h4]Bugs Fixed[/h4]
[list]
[*][b]Teleport after fight in dungeon[/b]
[u]After any fight in a dungeon, the player was sent to an out-of-bounds location in the dungeon map
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Arcade machines not allowing replay[/b]
[u]Arcade machines were not allowing replay
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Spells not launching[/b]
[u]Spells like Lightning Bomb would appear on top of the character and not launch at its target
[/u][/*]
[*][b]MP in fights[/b]
[u]Fixed MP(Magic Points) not being drained on spell usage
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Fix for Waystone message[/b]
[u]Fixed the message that shows up whenever the player interacts with a Waystone
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Crops Collision Detection[/b]
[u]Sometimes when trying to pickup a crop(example: carrots) it wouldn't detect the collision properly
[/u][/*]
[*][b]Fix for input icons[/b]
[u]Fixed the icons that show the inputs for determined actions for the current controller/keyboard
[/u][/*]
[/list]

As usual if anyone wants to report a bug or give feedback on the game, feel free to do so via the following methods:
[list]
[*] Opening a new ticket: [url=https://tickets.omegaleo.pt/]Ticket System[/url] 
[*] Sending an email to: [url=mailto:nunodiogo@omegaleo.pt]nunodiogo@omegaleo.pt[/url]
[*] Commenting on the discord server: [url=https://discord.omegaleo.pt]Discord Server[/url]
[/list]

With this I wish everyone happy holidays and also a happy new year!

notes.title: 19th February 2024 Public Beta Update
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

I apologize for the delay on bringing a new update for the game's public beta v1.5.0, been having some trouble balancing my work, university studies, and my duties as the game developer, work has been quite demanding these past few months and it has taken a bit of a toll on me and I apologize.

With that out of the way, here are the changes brought with this new update:

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Dungeon generation
[list]
[*] Temporarily disabled dungeons due to an issue with the way dungeon rooms are generated, allowing the possibility for the player to get soft-locked if the dungeon key is generated on a side blocked by the boss room;
[*] In place of the usual dungeon entrances, there's now a statue in the forest part of the map that generates fights with the bosses currently available in the game, and future bosses as soon as they are made available.
[/list]
[*] Spells not launching
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with spells like Lightning Bomb appearing on top of the character and not being launched, causing a soft-lock mid-fight.
[/list]
[*] Crops collision detection
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the collision detection for crops wasn't working properly so the player wouldn't be able to pick up the crop they were looking at.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Post-fight screens
[list]
[*] The victory screen has been remade to show the character's exp gain/level up separately and display the item drops after the characters;
[*] The defeat screen as been remade to be separate from the victory screen so as to better highlight a defeat.
[/list]
[*] Menu overhaul
[list]
[*] Removed the party option from the pause menu as it was no longer necessary
[*] Team menu
[list]
[*] Party members are now highlighted in orange;
[*] The menu now shows the list of characters on both pages;
[/list]
[*] Item Menu
[list]
[*] The item menu was changed to a tabbed window that now allows players to filter them by category.
[/list]
[*] Character summary screen
[list]
[*] This screen now shows the following tabs
[list]
[*] Character information and stats
[*] Grimoire and spells
[*] Equipment (and allow equipment to be changed in this screen)
[*] Element mastery (which will have a big role later on in the story)
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Pause menu
[list]
[*] Added icons to the pause menu options
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Minigame adjustments
[list]
[*] The boulder breaking and dodge the rocks minigames now take less time to finish;
[*] Minigames now give some money back at the end;
[*] Minigames now have a chance to give an item to raise a determined stat at the end.
[/list]
[*] Day/Night cycle adjustments
[list]
[*] Changed the day/night cycle so that now 1 real-world hour is equal to a full day in the game
[/list]
[*] Implemented a button mapping to allow players to skip the dialogue (still in testing)
[*] New music
[list]
[*] Added new music for:
[list]
[*] Title Screen
[*] Arcade
[*] Boss battle
[*] Aramore forest
[*] Fights
[*] Intro chapter when the drakians are invading
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

For instructions on how to switch to the public beta branch please look at the following video:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/kUxfSahq1wE]https://www.youtube.com/shorts/kUxfSahq1wE[/url]

This has been everything that's been done so far in terms of development, hopefully I'll be able to bring more regular updates soon.

As always any and all feedback is welcome and appreciated, the best options for it are either on the [url=https://github.com/omegaleo/NemithiaPublic/discussions]GitHub discussions forum[/url] or the [url=https://discord.omegaleo.pt]discord server[/url] or via email to nunodiogo@omegaleo.pt.

Thank you for your continued support and I hope you'll keep enjoying the game.

Kind Regards,
Nuno "Omega Leo" Diogo

notes.title: Beta Update Week 1 August 2023
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

I know it's been a long time since I last posted an update to the game and I want to apologize for that, these last few months have been demanding both with my work and my private life and because of that, the game's development has suffered some delays.

With that said, I want to announce some new changes that can be tested in the public beta channel:

[b]Story Intro[/b]
The game now has a proper story intro that shows some tutorials regarding movement and fighting and the battle between Arthur and Amolon Morrowstar.

[b]Changes to the fight screen[/b]
The fight screen has been revamped and now has new icons for HP and MP and the old buttons with text for the various actions(Fight, Spells, Item, Switch) have been replaced with icon buttons to make it more compact.
[url=https://twitter.com/NunoDiogoDev/status/1654240424872091652/photo/1][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FvUK2TjX0AMkzOr?format=jpg&name=medium[/img][/url]

[b]Changes to crops[/b]
After some feedback regarding the crop respawn timers some changes were made to reduce the times to an average of 30 minutes instead of being a daily occurrence.

[b]Interior Lighting[/b]
The interior map has been changed to add lighting sources(Ceiling lights, moonlight through windows, etc.) during nighttime.

[b]New Title screen[/b]
The title screen now has a new background that demonstrates the influence of the Drakians on Nemithia and new social icons have been added that lead to my discord server, youtube channel, and Twitch channel.

[b]Quests[/b]
Quests are now being implemented and can be seen by pressing O to toggle open the Quest Panel.
For now, only some main quests will appear and side quests are planned to be implemented at a later update.
Quest tracking icons have also been added to the minimap and will always show to help point to where the player needs to go.

[b]New character sprites[/b]
I'm currently in the process of remaking the overworld and fight sprites for all characters as will be apparent throughout this beta's gameplay, these are not final and some bugs may occur with rendering.

This has been everything that's been done so far in terms of game development and from now on I'll do my best to do these more regularly as well as try to stream more often and publish some devlogs on Youtube.

As always any and all feedback is welcome and appreciated, the best options for it are either on the [url=https://github.com/omegaleo/NemithiaPublic/discussions]GitHub discussions forum[/url] or the [url=https://discord.omegaleo.pt]discord server[/url].

Thank you for your time reading this post.

Kind Regards,
Nuno "Omega Leo" Diogo

notes.title: Demo game v1.3.0-51
notes.content:
As we draw near to the release of the 1st version of Nemithia's Early Access here on Steam, I made a lot of new changes to the demo to make it more "demo like", including changing completely the content of the demo to match the content of the main game, note that like with the main game this is also subject to bugs and may also suffer changes in the future, 

[h2]New features[/h2]

[list]
[*]New Demo plot, tied to the 1st chapter of the main game
[*]Improved experience & gold calculation
[*]Added shops
[*]Added equipment
[*]Added a loading screen
[*]Added new option for cutscene volume
[/list]


[h3]In case of a bug please report it on any of the following[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game's Steam forum
[*] Via email to support@nemithia.pt
[*] Via Nemithia's issue tracker
[/list]

Thank you all for your interest in Nemithia!
Hope to have new updates soon!

King Regards,
Nuno "Omega Leo" Diogo
